verdict.rationale: Spline documents a no-code interactivity model built from states, events and actions (e.g. a Scene Transition action fired from the Events system). Webhooks and the Real-time API extend this to external events, letting projects automatically trigger actions, update variables and respond to incoming data. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the event/trigger catalog and conditional rule logic, independent or hands-on corroboration that event-driven automation works as described.
